description: Mixed: strong technical (verifies, paraphrases, resolves) but weak branding/soft skills - no proper greeting spiel, no closing spiel, flat tone.
transcript:
[00:00] Client: I was charged twice for my monthly plan.
[00:04] Agent: Okay. What's the account number?
[00:08] Client: It's 55210.
[00:11] Agent: For security I need the PIN and billing postcode too.
[00:16] Client: PIN 3390, postcode AC12.
[00:21] Agent: Verified. So you're saying you see two identical charges for this month's plan, correct?
[00:28] Client: Yes, both for 49.99.
[00:32] Agent: I can see the duplicate. It was a billing system error on our side. I've reversed the second charge now and it will show back in 3 to 5 days.
[00:44] Client: Okay good.
[00:47] Agent: Anything else?
[00:49] Client: No that's it.
[00:51] Agent: Alright. Bye.
